engine: integrations/violet-afd dist (command registry) over foundations/violet core, MemoryDatabase

checks.name: root idea resolves in every framing
checks.note: tokens.resolve returns the composite value unchanged in all 5 framings; counts 300/300/300/300/300

checks.name: override in one framing, siblings unaffected
checks.note: token.override on book changes book only; public and product keep the root statement

evidence.book: For the book: garlic goes in the ground in October.
evidence.pub: Raised beds benefit from a thin layer of finished compost (#2).
evidence.prod: Raised beds benefit from a thin layer of finished compost (#2).

checks.name: root change reaches framings that did not override
checks.note: a root change is an override at the root itself (there is no update command); it reaches every framing that did not override, and an overriding framing keeps its own wording without notice

checks.name: subtract in a framing hides it from its child too
checks.note: token.subtract on public removes the idea from public and public-short; book keeps it

checks.name: reset restores
checks.note: reset of an override restores the root statement (true); reset of a subtract (an omit) is accepted but the idea stays hidden; reset appends an op (book ops for the idea: override,reset)

evidence.bookAfter: Raised beds benefit from a thin layer of finished compost (#2).

checks.name: add an idea only a framing has
checks.note: token.add on product: present in product, absent from core; adding an id the root already has is refused (TOKEN_ALREADY_EXISTS)

checks.name: copy: pins or follows
checks.note: copy follows its source (product read book v1 then book v2); lineage marks tracksSource=true; there is no pinned copy (a pin needs an override with the value at that moment)

checks.name: lineage in the grandchild
checks.note: token.lineage on public-short: core:add > public:override > public-short:inherit, resolvedAt public

checks.name: compare two framings
checks.note: tokens.compare (onlyDifferent) and compare.nodes both run; composite values compare whole, so a tags-only change counts the same as a reworded statement (4 differing rows)

checks.name: impact / dry run of one change and of a batch across nodes
checks.note: changes.impact previews one or up to 50 changes at ONE node and writes nothing (store unchanged: true); 51 changes refused (VALIDATION_ERROR); there is no input for changes at several nodes (an extra key is silently ignored), so a batch across framings cannot be previewed as one

checks.name: change one field without overriding the statement
checks.note: override replaces the whole value: after tagging in book and rewording at the root, book still reads "Potatoes attract more beneficial insects when flowers are near (#14)."; a partial value {tags} is accepted and drops the statement (book now reads undefined); a metadata key on override is silently dropped (not in its input schema)

evidence.bookStatement: Potatoes attract more beneficial insects when flowers are near (#14).

checks.name: read the tree as of an earlier moment
checks.note: no command takes a moment (asOf-like input: false); audit.list returns the change (1 event); replaying stored operations up to the moment through resolveInheritance gives "Raised beds are best harvested in the morning (#17).", but node edits, deletions and includes are not versioned, so that is outside the engine

evidence.replayed: Raised beds are best harvested in the morning (#17).

checks.name: idea held back from descendants until released
checks.note: emulated by a subtract in every child (hidden: true); a framing created later receives it at once (leak: true); release by reset does not bring it back, and no command removes the subtract; no held state exists

checks.name: constraint: public may not hold an idea tagged private
checks.note: a pattern constraint over the JSON of the value, scoped by id glob at public; validate reports (public {"totalTokens":298,"validTokens":289,"errors":9,"warnings":0,"infos":0}, public-short {"totalTokens":298,"validTokens":289,"errors":9,"warnings":0,"infos":0}); a write that breaks it is accepted, only reported

checks.name: other: ids, value types, node types
checks.note: any non-empty id except reserved segments ({"idea.Plant garlic in fall":"accepted","idea/i1":"accepted","idea.__proto__":"VALIDATION_ERROR","01HZX5ULIDLIKEID":"accepted","idea.i0000.v2":"accepted"}); a bare array value refused; composite resolvedValue is JSON text; tokens carry design metadata defaults (category custom, tier semantic); node type 'framing' refused, so framings use custom
